title: Identity derived homology comparison
statement: Let C be an abelian category with a chosen derived category [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], n any integer, and K any bounded below derived object. The canonical map Hⁿ(K)→Hⁿ(D⁺(Id)(K)) given by mapDerivedCategoryPlusHomologyFunctorIso for Id is Hⁿ of the inverse component of mapDerivedCategoryPlusIdIso at K.

source.place: Cohomology, Lemma 01F8 (lemma-functoriality), equations 01F9 (equation-functorial-derived) and 01FA (equation-functorial), Remark 01FB (remark-explain-arrow); sites-cohomology.tex Remark 08J6 for the site version.

proof.text: For a short complex S use LeftHomologyMapData for its identity map, with identity maps on the chosen kernel and homology objects, to show that mapHomologyIso for the identity functor is the identity. Unfold mapHomologicalComplexHomologyIso to obtain the same assertion on complexes, and cancel to get its inverse assertion.

Evaluate mapDerivedCategoryIdIso_factorsh on a complex in the homotopy quotient. Expand mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh_hom_app and mapHomotopyCategoryIdIso_hom_app. The complex identity comparison, homotopy factorization, and quotientCompQhIso components are identities by definition. Thus the derived identity comparison on Q(K) equals mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app K. Cancel that isomorphism to identify inverse components.

Use Localization.natTrans_ext for Q to compare mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso.hom with homology whiskered with mapDerivedCategoryIdIso.inv. On Q(K), expand mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso_hom_app_Q, substitute the two inverse identities, and cancel homologyFunctorFactors. Evaluate the resulting equality of natural transformations at X.

Evaluate the local unbounded comparison at the bounded-below inclusion of K and compose on the right with homology of the compatibility inverse. Unfold both bounded-below comparison isomorphisms and the bounded-below homology functor; map_preimage and map_comp identify the composites.

proof_origin.place: Equations 01F9--01FA; canonical localization constructions in ExactFunctor.lean, realized using Mathlib homology map data and localization extensionality.

from.place: Identify the canonical cohomology pullback map in the stalk calculation.

lean.statement: theorem identityDerivedHomologyComparison {C : Type*} [Category C] [Abelian C] [HasDerivedCategory C] (n : ℤ) (K : DerivedCategory.Plus C) : ((𝟭 C).mapDerivedCategoryPlusHomologyFunctorIso n).hom.app K = (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor C n).map ((mapDerivedCategoryPlusIdIso C).inv.app K)
